description_en: Creates a batch card operation task
kebab_example: aliyun cc5g create-batch-operate-cards-task --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --operate-type BreakNetwork --threshold 100 --effect-type CurrentMonth --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateBatchOperateCardsTask

parameters.help_en: The name of the batch operation task
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en: The description of the batch operation task
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en:
Ensures the idempotence of the request. Generate a parameter value from your client to make sure that the value is unique among different requests. This parameter supports only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length.

If you do not specify this parameter, the system automatically uses the RequestId of the API request as the ClientToken. The RequestId may be different for each API request
parameters.help_zh:
保证请求幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。只支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符。
若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId可能不一样
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to perform a dry run for this request. Valid values:

true: Sends a check request without creating a batch card operation task. The system checks for required parameters, request format, and service limits. If the check fails, the system returns a corresponding error. If the check passes, the system returns the `DryRunOperation` error code.

false (default): Sends a normal request and creates a batch card operation task after the check passes
parameters.help_zh:
是否只预检此次请求。取值：
true：发送检查请求，不会创建批量操作卡任务。检查项包括是否填写了必需参数、请求格式、业务限制。如果检查不通过，则返回对应错误。如果检查通过，则返回错误码`DryRunOperation`。
false（默认值）：发送正常请求，通过检查直接创建批量操作卡任务
parameters.name: dry_run

parameters.help_en: A list of IDs of 5G cloud connectors. You can specify up to 10 IDs
parameters.name: wireless_cloud_connector_ids

parameters.help_en: A list of Integrated Circuit Card Identifiers (ICCIDs) of the cards. You can specify up to 200 ICCIDs
parameters.name: iccids

parameters.help_en: The path where the ICCID file is stored
parameters.name: iccids_oss_file_path

parameters.help_en:
The restriction type. Valid values:

BreakNetwork: Disconnects the network when the data usage threshold is reached.

LimitRate: Throttles the network speed when the data usage threshold is reached.

Alarm: Sends an alert when the data usage threshold is reached
parameters.help_zh:
限制类型，取值：

BreakNetwork: 达量断网
LimitRate: 达量限速
Alarm: 达量告警
parameters.name: operate_type

parameters.help_en: The data usage threshold. Unit: MB
parameters.name: threshold

parameters.help_en:
The effective type. Valid values:

CurrentMonth: Takes effect in the current month.

ContinualMonth: Takes effect for consecutive months
parameters.help_zh:
生效类型，取值：

CurrentMonth：当月生效
ContinualMonth：连续生效
parameters.name: effect_type

BatchOperateCardsTaskId.description_en: The ID of the batch operation task

OperateResultOssFilePath.description_zh: 批量操作结果的文件路径
